map.盈亏平衡ROAS（Break-even ROAS）是指广告投入刚好不亏不赚时的广: Break-even ROAS is the return on ad spend at which the campaign exactly breaks even, neither losing nor making money. Below this value advertising loses money; above it there is profit.
For example with a 40% gross margin (0.4), break-even ROAS = 1 / 0.4 = 2.5
map.意味着ROAS达到2.5时，广告投入刚好收回成本，不赚不亏。: which means that at ROAS 2.5 the ad spend just covers cost, with no profit and no loss.

map.毛利率怎么取？: How should gross margin be measured?
map.用（收入−货成本−履约）/收入，含运费退换更准；只扣进货成本会低估平衡 ROAS: Use (revenue − goods cost − fulfillment) / revenue; including shipping and returns is more accurate, since deducting only purchase cost understates break-even ROAS.
